question:
**Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

The annual extraction of this _________ costs around $10,000,000.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**ore**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• Homonyms are words that sound the same but have different meanings.
 
• '**Ore**' is the correct homonym to fill in the blank as it refers to a mineral or a combination of minerals that can be mined for profit.
 
• In this sentence, "**ore**" refers to a naturally occurring mineral from which valuable substances, such as metals, can be extracted.

The correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence**: *The annual extraction of this ore __costs around $10,000,000.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• '**O'er**' is an archaic form of 'over' and is rarely used in modern English.
 
• '**Arc**' can also refer to a part of a circle or a portion of an electrical circuit.
 
• '**Or**' is used as a noun to refer to a heraldic colour gold or yellow.
